title: Hearing on pregnancy and birth outcomes for immigrant New Yorkers
summary: The Committees on Immigration, Health, and Women and Gender Equity will examine pregnancy- and birth-related health outcomes among immigrant New Yorkers, who make up about 38 percent of the city's population. The hearing also covers a related bill, Introduction 1185, which would bar the City from using its resources to enforce restrictions on reproductive care. Officials from the Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs, the Health Department, and advocacy groups are expected to testify.
